CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

2. Which response best shows understanding of Church Service WORSHIP? (1 mark)
   A. Use Church Service WORSHIP to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Church Service WORSHIP has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Church Service WORSHIP with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Church Service WORSHIP.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS.
   B. Apply the teaching of Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

5. Which response best shows understanding of God as the CREATION? (1 mark)
   A. Say God as the CREATION has no place in daily life.
   B. Use God as the CREATION to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing God as the CREATION.
   D. Apply the teaching of God as the CREATION with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

7. Which response best shows understanding of Greatest? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Greatest.
   B. Apply the teaching of Greatest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Greatest has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Greatest to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Handling the Bible BIBLE? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Handling the Bible BIBLE with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Handling the Bible BIBLE has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Handling the Bible BIBLE to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Handling the Bible BIBLE.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Name of God? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Name of God.
   B. Use Name of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Name of God has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Name of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Christian? (1 mark)
   A. Use Christian to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Christian.
   C. Apply the teaching of Christian with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Christian has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Places of? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Places of.
   B. Use Places of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Places of has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Places of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible BIBLE? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Bible BIBLE has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible BIBLE.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Bible BIBLE with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Bible BIBLE to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Places of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Church Service WORSHIP and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Behaviour in the WORSHIP and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain God as the CREATION and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
